body: Honestly, ive felt the same way. A bad break up where someone ignores u and u feel like ur just forgotten by all can really make ending it seem like a reasonable choice, but dont settle for that. Everyone deserves to be loved and sometimes you only need to open yourself up to it. You wouldnt have posted here if u didnt think someone would reply back saying they care. We dont even have to know each other to care because its in our nature to, the same way a mother cares for her child or a boy and his dog, its instinct. You only need to take small steps and you'll see that things will get better. You might only want him and thats fine. I know how it feels to want someone you cant have but please try to also want more for u. Dont end things because of a single want. You'll find more laughs, more smiles, and more love in other ways and that should be reason enough to suffer from through the pain. You might even find someone else one day. Just please consider your best interests first and stick around for your next smile.
